name: @activepieces/piece-easy-peasy-ai
description: Create professional-quality music in any genre with just a text prompt. From hip-hop to classical, our AI generates custom tracks for your projects in seconds.

auth.description: Easy Peasy AI API Key. Get it from [Easy Peasy AI Settings](https://easy-peasy.ai/settings) - Navigate to the **API** tab from the top bar

customGeneratorText.name: customGeneratorText
customGeneratorText.description: Generate custom text for any purpose using the EasyPeasy AI template engine

keywords.description: What do you want to generate? (max 1000 characters)

extra1.description: Additional context or background information (optional, max 1000 characters)

language.description: Language for the generated text (default: English)

shouldUseGPT4.description: Use GPT-4 model for generation (may incur higher costs)

aiMetadata.description: Generate freeform text from keywords/instructions via Easy-Peasy.AI's custom-generator preset. Choose this for open-ended copy or content generation where no purpose-specific template fits; supply the prompt in Keywords, optionally set language, output count, and a GPT-4 toggle. Each call produces fresh generated text, so it is not idempotent.

generateAiImage.name: generateAiImage
generateAiImage.description: Generate AI images based on text prompts using various models and styles

prompt.description: Description of the image you want to generate

model.description: AI model to use for image generation

style.description: Art style or aesthetic for the generated image (e.g., "oil painting", "watercolor", "cyberpunk")

artist.description: Art style inspired by a specific artist (e.g., "Van Gogh", "Picasso")

useHD.description: Generate image in HD quality (may incur higher costs)

image.description: Optional URL to a reference image for style consistency

aiMetadata.description: Generate an image from a text prompt via Easy-Peasy.AI, selecting the generation model (DALL-E 3/2, Midjourney, or Stable Diffusion) and optionally style, artist inspiration, dimensions, HD quality, and a reference image URL. Choose this to produce visual content from a description; the prompt and model are required. Each call creates a new image, so it is not idempotent.

getAiTranscription.name: getAiTranscription
getAiTranscription.description: Generate AI transcriptions from audio files with speaker detection and enhanced quality options

url.description: URL to the audio file to transcribe

name.description: Name or title for this transcription

audio_type.description: Type of audio content being transcribed

detect_speakers.description: Automatically detect and identify different speakers in the audio

enhanced_quality.description: Use enhanced quality processing for better transcription accuracy

aiMetadata.description: Submit an audio file (by URL) to Easy-Peasy.AI for transcription, with optional speaker detection and enhanced-quality processing. Choose this to convert podcasts, interviews, meetings, lectures, or other recordings into text; the audio URL, a name, and an audio type are required. Each call creates a new transcription, so it is not idempotent.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
